title: Hong Kong Considers Offshore Yuan Venture Fund for Tech Industries
detail: Hong Kong is considering launching a new offshore yuan-denominated venture fund targeting technology and emerging industries. The proposal represents a significant capital markets development that would deepen Hong Kong's role as a hub for renminbi internationalization while channeling RMB liquidity into high-growth sectors. The initiative aligns with Beijing's broader strategy to expand offshore yuan usage and support tech investment amid ongoing US export controls.
